adjudication.rationale: In `AddGuestsDialog.tsx` the client defines its own `ZAddGuestsInputSchema` (`z.array(z.string().email()).refine(...)`) instead of reusing the server schema (`packages/trpc/.../addGuests.schema.ts`), creating duplicated validation logic. The diff already shows drift: the client enforces uniqueness via `refine`, while the server input schema only validates `guests: z.array(z.string().email())` and does not enforce uniqueness. This is a concrete maintainability/consistency issue grounded in the diff, even if it may not immediately break behavior for normal UI usage.
